findings.description: plans/codexu-roadmap.md lines 2322-2327 (under the now `DONE 2026-05-13` Phase 3h section) say `hooks/config.js` will "Update getConfigRoot() line 32-34: hardcoded ~/.claude → prefer CODEX_HOME env or ~/.codex/". The shipped plugin's hooks/config.js does the opposite per the job's load-bearing INV-6: it reads PLUGIN_DATA and throws when unset, with no fallback to CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex/. This direct factual contradiction will mislead future engineers about how options-mode state is rooted.
findings.suggestedFix: In plans/codexu-roadmap.md, update the `hooks/config.js` bullet in the LOC inventory (lines ~2322-2327) to reflect the shipped behavior: getConfigRoot() reads PLUGIN_DATA (set by codex plugin discovery per discovery.rs:184-186) and fails loud if unset. Drop the CODEX_HOME/~/.codex preference language.

findings.description: plans/codexu-roadmap.md lines 2278-2289 "What it does today" describes the upstream Claude plugin's tag protocol — `<options-mode>continue</options-mode>` and a single closing-tag-or-choice contract. The shipped codex port (verified in packages/codexu-options-mode-plugin/hooks/config.js:12-15 and skills/options-mode/SKILL.md) uses a different tag set: `no-question`, `task-complete`, `background-task`, `background-agent`. There is no `continue` tag in the shipped plugin. Now that this paragraph sits under a header marked `DONE 2026-05-13`, readers will reasonably read it as "what the shipped 3h plugin does" and form an incorrect mental model.
findings.suggestedFix: Either (a) reframe the "What it does today" block at plans/codexu-roadmap.md:2278-2289 as "What the upstream plugin did (pre-migration baseline)" with the same content, OR (b) replace it with a current-state summary that names the shipped tag set (no-question, task-complete, background-task, background-agent) and the four modes (off/on/strict/auto) per packages/codexu-options-mode-plugin/README.md.
findings.resolution: Rewrote plans/codexu-roadmap.md §Phase 3h body to match shipped state. Batched fix closing F-001..F-005.

findings.description: plans/codexu-roadmap.md lines 2339-2353 (LOC inventory bullets for `commands/options-mode.toml` and `hooks/options-mode-statusline.{ps1,sh}`) still presents both topics as open future choices: slash command is "Two options: (1) UserPromptSubmit hook OR (2) convert to a skill", and statusline scripts "Drop, OR upstream a new StatusLineItem variant". The shipped plugin already chose: UserPromptSubmit hook handles the toggle AND a documentation-only skill exists at skills/options-mode/SKILL.md; statusline scripts were kept under apps/statusline/ for forward-compat (per README "Known Gaps"), not dropped. The "choose later" framing is stale.
